predicates.statement: All retained coordinate and mass variables are real; no complex branch is used.
alpha and beta are relative masses satisfying alpha+beta=1; the source does not state positivity here and this package does not add it.
For each retained expression, both old/new squared-distance radicands are positive and unequal. This is an explicitly retained nondegenerate stratum, not a claim about every physical trajectory.
The real square roots and every displayed reciprocal, node difference, and square-root-sum denominator are nonzero on the retained stratum.

verifier_scope_note: The exact namespace records every symbol as real without inferring real:false. Relational positivity, inequality, and alpha+beta=1 remain explicit contract predicates; exact ZERO does not silently prove them.
